prompt: Create a square, soft pastel anime close-up portrait of a cute chibi-style girl with bubblegum pink hair in twin ponytails, large glossy blue eyes, tiny pouty mouth, and heavily blushed cheeks. She rests her chin on one hand in a shy, sleepy, slightly mischievous pose, looking forward with a dreamy expression. Add a small white cat mascot sleeping on top of her head, with pink inner ears and a curled tail, and place one yellow star hair clip on the right ponytail plus two small glowing yellow sparkle shapes on the left side. The girl wears a simple white long-sleeve top with soft folds. Use a warm indoor background with blurred wooden tones and a bright window-like area, shallow depth of field, creamy lighting, high-key pastel colors, delicate line art, glossy highlights in the hair and eyes, soft blush gradients, and a kawaii Japanese anime screenshot aesthetic. Include exactly 4 distinct decorative elements: 1 sleeping white cat on her head, 1 yellow star hair clip, and 2 yellow sparkle shapes. No readable text, no watermark, no extra characters.
